book.name: 2 Timotiyo
book.title: 2 Tixinri Kpashiri Pawlo Kirukate Timotiyo Chinanu

content: Wa tye pumatanu. Wa ralipregognekaka waneplu kyowikolgognekakapa.

Gi rixanu wanepna yine wannananuko galuknachinewa, sroschi galukachine potu, tsru gixashatnachinewa, galixkotnachinewa, mupashiregolune, kaaligiruklerune, poyagnu mchinkane, Goyakalu mkagwakpiraklene,
rumumturetna galuklewle mixkane, mumkata gipoyikgaletkane, kapataklerune, makotmanetnachinwa kmatsurune, kigleru gayegixachine,
gitokoko gayegixlewatyachine, mgirukowjetkane, wannananuko getpotutnachinewa. Goyakalu pnute gigleretashatkaluru rushinikna.
Gipashiregowlu pixkalutu waneyna, seyni gipashiregowlu giyakle nutatna. Nyi putspalatini pixa.
Gi rixanu wannayegirune panchikaka yoshmakjetnachinewa. Kashichanshinikanutkalurone pixka rixkana suxone mshinikanune molemukochiretachrone, gixo getsotanrewlukaka koseekanune.
Psolgogneko rujga gimatlegognenatna. Gi pagogneko rumkata gapkapletluna galikakpotunanu tokanchi gimatikolu.
Gane ga wa Gampre kamnixini pixkalu wa Mosisi, waneko pixka wa nyi gixa kamnixletlu galikakpotunanu tokanchi. Jejinni gimtukanshinikanutkalune. Gi kiglepiranyegirunni galixlewluya.
Seyni wannapni gi wa kosekpotutanunna. Gi rixanu wa seproloklena gipgujetkalurupni pejnuruneko yegi, wannani pixka.
Goyakalu gitakanshinikanutlu pejnuruko Wale tokanchi yonatkaluru
Ga wa pixa getjenatlu nunkaklewle, ga wa nixjetyawaka, ga wa nushinikjetyawaka, ga wa nalixlewle, ga wa nmapognanre ga wa nushiniklewle, ga wa nkashnantakgognewle,
ga wa nkojwakikolkaka, ga wa nsalewninrikaka, wa Gantiyokiya nuknogjeru, ga wa Gikonyoya, ga wa Listraya, gi pixkalutu kojwawakchikaka nakota. Ga wa pejnuruyako Gitsrukaachi koshpakno.
Ga wa pejnuruneko kgipashiregolune galuka gixletachine Kristo Gesoya kojwaakalunepni.
Ga wa muglene jejine ga wa kyokwirewaklerune pnute rixa kosekletanna. Yokwirewatanna ga wa yokwitkona.
Seyni pomkagitanru pixa wa pyimakikolu ga wa palixpotutanru, pumatinri ginnanwa pyimakjene.
Ga wa pmatureyakawa pumatlu kpashiri yonchi. Walenwa kgimatkaleru pumkata gixjeru gognewatikaluru chinanu, Kristo Geso galixikolu chinanu.

Goyakalu gitakanshinikanutlu pejnuruko Wale Tokanu Yonatkaluru. Giyagni pejnuruko Goyakalu yonjixanrukaka walenwa yimaklewle gapi, ga wa chigetjeru gapi, ga wa potukatlewlu gapi, ga wa tseruwakanshinikanrewlu gapi poyagkaklewluyapa,
galpokotachripni Goyakalu gayinerute. Mmagatikatupa pejnuruko kigleru kamrurchi chinanu.
